entities.description_en: The UAE's federal statistics office (formerly the Federal Competitiveness and Statistics Authority, FCSA), producing official national statistics such as GDP, population estimates, CPI, foreign trade, labour force and vital statistics, plus competitiveness and SDG reporting.
The UAE Government's official open data portal (still branded Bayanat.ae), operated by FCSC, aggregating datasets published by federal and emirate-level government entities.

The UAE's central bank and regulator of banks and (since the 2020 merger of the former Insurance Authority) insurers; publishes monetary, banking, exchange-rate, financial-stability and insurance-sector statistics.

Federal ministry for economic policy, business regulation, SMEs, consumer protection, intellectual property and tourism; renamed from the Ministry of Economy on 20 June 2025 (moec.gov.ae now redirects to moet.gov.ae), when foreign trade moved to the new Ministry of Foreign Trade.
Federal ministry responsible for the federal budget, public finance policy and government finance statistics, international tax and investment treaties.

entities.name_en: Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation
entities.description_en: Federal ministry regulating the private-sector labour market and Emiratisation; publishes employment, establishment and labour-market indicators.
Federal health ministry; publishes national health statistics, an open data API and a statistics dashboard.
Federal ministry for general (school) education; publishes student, school, teacher and education-expenditure statistics.

entities.name_en: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research
entities.description_en: Federal ministry for higher education and scientific research; publishes higher-education open data.

entities.name_en: Ministry of Climate Change and Environment
entities.description_en: Federal ministry for climate, environment, agriculture, fisheries and food safety; publishes environmental, agricultural and food-security data.

Federal ministry for energy, petroleum, water, federal roads, transport (land and maritime) and housing policy; it also runs an open data portal at opendata.moei.gov.ae (launched GITEX 2024, 200+ datasets), which refused connections during verification and is therefore not listed as a source. The UAE left OPEC/OPEC+ effective 1 May 2026.

entities.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology
entities.description_en: Federal ministry for industrial development, standards, metrology, conformity and advanced technology; publishes industrial-sector data.
Federal ministry created on 20 June 2025 (split from the former Ministry of Economy) for trade policy, CEPA trade agreements and export promotion; publishes trade dashboards and economic reports.
Federal interior ministry (police, traffic, civil defence); publishes road-safety, traffic and security open data.

entities.name_ar: الهيئة الاتحادية للهوية والجنسية والجمارك وأمن المنافذ
entities.name_en: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security
entities.description_en: Federal authority for ID, residency, citizenship, customs and border ports (absorbed the former Federal Customs Authority); publishes service-transaction and customs open data.

Federal ministry for social welfare, social support, people of determination and non-profit/community organisations; formerly the Ministry of Community Development (old domain mocd.gov.ae), with family affairs now under a separate Ministry of Family.
Federal culture ministry, formerly the Ministry of Culture and Youth (mcy.gov.ae now redirects to moc.gov.ae); publishes cultural statistics.
Federal sports ministry established in 2024, replacing the General Authority of Sports (gas.gov.ae now redirects to sports.gov.ae).

entities.name_en: Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority
entities.description_en: Federal regulator for telecoms and digital government; publishes telecom subscription, ICT and digital-government indicators.
Federal civil aviation regulator; publishes aviation open data (air traffic, aircraft movements, licences).
Federal nuclear and radiation-safety regulator (oversees the Barakah nuclear plant); publishes regulatory and inspection data.
Federal authority administering VAT, excise tax and corporate tax; publishes tax registration and collection data.

Federal capital-markets regulator that replaced the Securities and Commodities Authority (SCA) on 1 January 2026 under Federal Decree-Laws 32 and 33 of 2025; sca.gov.ae now redirects to uaecma.gov.ae.
The UAE federal export credit agency; reports export-credit and trade-finance support figures.
Federal ministry (established 2023) for investment policy and FDI attraction; publishes FDI figures and investment reports.

entities.name_en: Federal Authority for Government Human Resources
entities.description_en: Federal authority managing HR policy for the federal government; publishes federal government workforce data.
Federal meteorology and seismology centre (ncm.ae redirects to ncm.gov.ae); publishes weather observations and climate reports.
Federal justice ministry (federal courts, notaries, legal affairs); publishes judicial open data and statistics.
Federal establishment running public hospitals and primary-care centres (mainly in the northern emirates); publishes health-service open data.
The UAE's official news agency; relays official announcements and figures from federal and local government entities.

The federal government's media office under the UAE Cabinet (formerly the Government Communication Office / UAE Government Communication Office); publishes Cabinet decisions and announcements on uaecabinet.ae.

Abu Dhabi's official statistics office (SCAD), the sole reference for official statistics of the emirate, publishing population/census, GDP, prices, foreign trade, labour, tourism and sector statistics.

The Abu Dhabi Government's official open data platform, operated by the Abu Dhabi Digital Authority (ADDA) and launched in 2020 by the then Department of Government Support, aggregating datasets published by Abu Dhabi government entities.

entities.name_en: Department of Culture and Tourism - Abu Dhabi
entities.description_en: Abu Dhabi government department regulating and promoting tourism and culture; announces hotel guest, occupancy and visitor figures and publishes annual reports.

entities.name_en: Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development
entities.description_en: Abu Dhabi government department responsible for economic policy, business licensing and industrial development; announces economic, licensing and investment figures.
The regulator of Abu Dhabi's healthcare sector; publishes health statistics through open data dashboards and announces health-sector figures.

entities.name_en: Abu Dhabi Department of Education and Knowledge
entities.description_en: Abu Dhabi's education regulator (ADEK) for private schools, nurseries and higher education; announces student, school and programme figures.

entities.name_en: Department of Municipalities and Transport - Abu Dhabi
entities.description_en: Abu Dhabi government department overseeing municipalities, urban planning, construction and transport (including Abu Dhabi Mobility and the Abu Dhabi Real Estate Centre).

Abu Dhabi Mobility (AD Mobility) is the new brand identity of the Integrated Transport Centre (ITC), responsible for public transport, land, maritime and aviation transport regulation, parking, tolls and vehicle licensing in Abu Dhabi.
Abu Dhabi's real estate sector regulator (ADREC), publishing real estate market data, dashboards and semi-annual market reports for the emirate.
Abu Dhabi government department responsible for the emirate's public finances and financial policy; issues financial-policy news and finance-related publications.
The official media office of the Abu Dhabi Government, relaying news and figures announced by Abu Dhabi government entities.
Abu Dhabi's police force; announces road safety, traffic and crime-related figures through its media centre.
Abu Dhabi's environmental regulator (EAD), monitoring air quality, marine, biodiversity and groundwater and publishing environmental research and data.

entities.name_en: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority
entities.description_en: Abu Dhabi's agriculture, livestock and food safety authority (ADAFSA); announces agricultural production, farm and food-safety figures.
Abu Dhabi's energy sector regulator (DoE) for electricity, water, wastewater and petroleum products; publishes annual and technical reports on sector performance.
Abu Dhabi's stock exchange (ADX), publishing daily, weekly, monthly and yearly trading statistics, index performance and investor-type/nationality trading data.

entities.name_en: Department of Community Development - Abu Dhabi
entities.description_en: Abu Dhabi's social sector regulator (DCD); publishes social sector studies, research and survey results (e.g. quality of life, sports and physical activity surveys).
Abu Dhabi government's investment promotion office (ADIO); announces foreign direct investment, company attraction and incentive programme figures.
Abu Dhabi authority administering the social support programme for low-income Emirati families; announces beneficiary and disbursement figures.
Abu Dhabi authority for citizens' housing (ADHA); announces housing benefit packages, loans and housing project figures. Its website moved from adha.gov.ae to iskan.abudhabi.

entities.name_en: General Administration of Abu Dhabi Customs
entities.description_en: Abu Dhabi's customs administration; publishes an annual foreign trade statistics booklet for the emirate and an annual performance report.

Abu Dhabi's international financial centre and free zone (ADGM), whose authorities (Registration Authority, FSRA) announce figures on registered entities, assets under management and financial-sector growth.

Dubai's official statistics body, affiliated to the Dubai Digital Authority (Digital Dubai); created by Dubai Law No. 24 of 2023 as legal successor to the former Dubai Statistics Center (dsc.gov.ae, now redirecting to data.dubai) and the Dubai Data Establishment, it publishes Dubai's population, CPI, national accounts, labour and trade statistics.

Dubai's unified official data platform run by the Dubai Data and Statistics Establishment; it replaced the Dubai Pulse open data platform (dubaipulse.gov.ae now redirects here) and hosts open datasets from Dubai government entities.

entities.name_en: Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism (DET)
entities.description_en: Dubai government department for economy and tourism (formed in 2021 by merging Dubai Economy and Dubai Tourism/DTCM); publishes official visitor arrivals, hotel performance, Dubai FDI Monitor and business-licensing figures.
Dubai's real estate registration and regulatory department; publishes official real estate transaction, rent, mortgage, project and price-index data.
Dubai's health regulator and provider; publishes the annual Dubai Health Statistical Yearbook (births, deaths, hospital activity, health workforce and facilities) and Dubai health accounts.
Dubai's regulator of private education; publishes official data on private schools, students, early childhood centres and higher education institutions, plus school inspection ratings.
Dubai's municipal authority for planning, building permits, food safety, waste and environment; publishes figures on these services in press releases and open datasets on Data Dubai.
Dubai's roads and transport authority; publishes public transport ridership (metro, tram, buses, taxis, marine), road and licensing figures in annual reports and press releases.
Dubai's customs administration; announces customs transactions, Dubai non-oil foreign trade and seizure figures.
Official media office of the Government of Dubai; relays announcements and figures from Dubai government entities in Arabic and English.
Dubai's police force; publishes open data on major crime rates per 100,000 population, emergency (999) call statistics and traffic accident statistics.

Dubai's electricity and water utility authority (a PJSC listed on DFM since 2022, majority government-owned); publishes annual statistics on generation capacity, consumption, customers and renewable energy.

entities.name_en: Department of Finance – Government of Dubai
entities.description_en: Dubai government finance department; prepares and announces the Dubai Government general budget and, through its Public Debt Management Office, publishes fiscal and economic overview data.
Dubai's securities exchange; publishes trading bulletins, index levels, market capitalisation, foreign ownership and historical market data.
Government of Dubai-owned operator of Dubai International (DXB) and Al Maktoum International (DWC) airports; publishes official passenger, flight and baggage traffic figures.

entities.name_en: Department of Statistics and Community Development (DSCD) - Sharjah
entities.description_en: Sharjah's official statistics body; runs the Sharjah Census (Census 2025 results released June 2026), the Statistical Yearbook, statistical bulletins and the Sharjah open data portal.
Sharjah's economic development and business licensing department; publishes annual reports and business-licence reports for the emirate.
Official media office of the Government of Sharjah; issues official news and statements on behalf of Sharjah government entities.
Sharjah's real estate registry; publishes monthly and periodic real estate transaction values, volumes and investor nationalities.

entities.name_en: Sharjah Commerce and Tourism Development Authority (SCTDA)
entities.description_en: Sharjah's tourism authority; collects hotel data through its hotel statistics system and publishes hotel performance statistics.
Regulator of private schools, nurseries and training centres in Sharjah; publishes headline private-education statistics.

Ajman's official statistics authority, reorganised under its current name by Amiri Decree No. 8 of 2022 (formerly the Ajman Statistics and Competitiveness Center, est. 2017); publishes the Ajman statistical yearbook, Ajman in Figures and quarterly bulletins.
Ajman's digital government department; runs the Ajman government portal and the Ajman Data open data platform (data.ajman.ae).
Ajman's economic development and business licensing department; publishes licensing datasets (licences by activity and area, economic permits).

entities.name_en: Department of Land and Real Estate Regulation - Ajman
entities.description_en: Ajman's land registry and real estate regulator; publishes real estate transaction statistics and monthly market figures.

entities.name_en: Department of Tourism, Culture and Media - Ajman
entities.description_en: Ajman's tourism, culture and media department (renamed from the Ajman Tourism Development Department, which it superseded); publishes hotel and visitor statistics.
Ajman's municipal and urban planning authority; publishes an annual Statistical Book and open datasets on municipal services.
Official media office of the Government of Ajman; publishes official Ajman government news and publications.

Ras Al Khaimah's official statistics body (Emiri Law No. 2 of 2016), also referred to on the RAK government portal as the RAK Center for Statistics and Studies; publishes monthly, quarterly and annual statistics for the emirate.

entities.name_en: Department of Economic Development - Ras Al Khaimah
entities.description_en: Ras Al Khaimah's economic development and business licensing department; announces licensing figures (new and active licences, licensed capital).

entities.name_en: Ras Al Khaimah Tourism Development Authority (RAKTDA)
entities.description_en: Ras Al Khaimah's tourism authority; publishes visitor arrival and hotel performance figures.

entities.name_en: Ras Al Khaimah Government Media Office
entities.description_en: Official media office of the Government of Ras Al Khaimah; publishes government news and statements.
Fujairah's official statistics body, renamed from the Department of Statistics and Planning (est. 1997) by Decree No. 6 of 2009; publishes the annual Fujairah Statistical Book.
Official media office of the Government of Fujairah (Emiri Decree No. 10 of 2014); publishes news on the Ruler's and government's activities.
Multilateral financial institution; publishes Article IV country reports and macroeconomic estimates and projections (World Economic Outlook) for the UAE.
International development bank; publishes the World Development Indicators and World Bank Open Data country series covering the UAE's economy, population, environment and social indicators.
Statistics division of UN DESA; compiles internationally comparable country statistics (UNdata / UN System Data Commons) and the UN Comtrade international merchandise trade database.

UN specialized agency for tourism (renamed from UNWTO to UN Tourism in 2024; unwto.org now redirects to untourism.int); publishes international tourism arrivals, receipts and accommodation statistics by country.
UN agency for the world of work; publishes harmonised labour statistics (ILOSTAT) including UAE labour force, employment and unemployment indicators.
Intergovernmental renewable energy agency headquartered in Abu Dhabi; publishes renewable capacity, generation and investment statistics (IRENASTAT) and country energy profiles including the UAE.

entities.name_en: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries
entities.description_en: Oil producers' organisation; publishes the Annual Statistical Bulletin and Monthly Oil Market Report with UAE crude production, reserves and export data. The UAE announced its exit from OPEC and OPEC+ effective 1 May 2026 (WAM, 28 April 2026), so UAE coverage is a former-member/historical series from that date.

entities.name_ar: المركز الإحصائي لدول مجلس التعاون لدول الخليج العربية
entities.description_en: Regional statistics body of the Gulf Cooperation Council (Statistical Centre for the Cooperation Council for the Arab Countries of the Gulf); publishes harmonised GCC and member-state statistics including the UAE.
UN health agency; publishes country health statistics (Global Health Observatory, WHO Data) including UAE life expectancy, mortality and disease indicators.
Intergovernmental energy agency; publishes country energy balances, electricity, renewables and CO2 emissions data including a UAE country profile.

sources.description_en: FCSC's SDMX-based (.Stat Suite) data explorer with official UAE time series by subject: population estimates (from 1970), births, deaths, marriages and divorces, education, health, security and traffic accidents, social and cultural statistics, national accounts, CPI, balance of payments, trade, labour, energy and environment.

sources.name_ar: الأخبار الصحفية - المركز الاتحادي للتنافسية والإحصاء
sources.description_en: FCSC announcements of newly released official figures, e.g. quarterly and half-year real and non-oil GDP (H1 2026 release of 9 Oct 2026) and joint surveys with federal entities; archive back to 2015.

sources.name_ar: تقارير وإصدارات المركز الاتحادي للتنافسية والإحصاء
sources.description_en: Statistical, competitiveness and SDG publications filterable by year (2015 onward), e.g. 'Unified UAE Numbers' (2025), XDGs report and the UAE Voluntary National Review (2026).

National open data catalogue (about 3,580 datasets from 57 entities as of Oct 2026) with XLSX resources and a JSON API (DatasetResources/GetDatasetResource). FCSC's homepage 'Open Data' link points to opendata.fcsc.gov.ae, which serves the same national catalogue (entity datasets such as @ministry-education, @federal-customs-authority); that host is Cloudflare-protected and could not be loaded directly.

Research and Statistics Department output (Data and Statistics Centre): Monthly Statistical Bulletin (money supply, monetary survey, central bank balance sheet, reserves, deposits, credit), monthly monetary and banking developments, Credit Sentiment Survey (PDF + XLSX) and MSME surveys.

Quarterly Economic Review, quarterly Monetary, Banking and Financial Markets Developments, Financial Stability Report, CBUAE Annual Report, working papers and the Annual Statistical Report for the Insurance Sector.
Official daily dirham exchange rates against major currencies and the Emirates Interbank Offered Rate (EIBOR), plus a summary of economic indicators.
CBUAE press releases (HTML with PDF copies) on policy-rate decisions, regulation, banking-sector figures and international cooperation.
Open data hub linking MoEc Open Data datasets, the FDI dashboard, International Trade Map, economic reports, annual economic and statistical reports, and the Essential Goods Prices Platform.
National tourism performance indicators: travel and tourism share of GDP, international tourist spending, hotel revenues, number of hotels and rooms, hotel occupancy and guests.
Ministry reports and publications, including annual economic reports and sector studies.
Ministry news and press releases, often carrying figures on company registrations, SMEs, IP, consumer-protection and tourism performance.

Federal fiscal data filterable by group: approved budget by sector, budget execution, federal budget revenues and expenses, general government revenue and expenditure, government finance statistics, public debt outstanding and transactions in assets and liabilities; the page advertises real-time API access. The parent open data hub (/en/open-data/) adds data-visualisation, geospatial, real-time and treaties dashboards.
Quarterly and annual UAE Government Finance Statistics (revenues, expenditures, assets and liabilities) compiled under the IMF GFSM 2014 methodology.
Monthly 'Pulse of Finance' newsletter (PDF) with ministry news, statements, studies and fiscal data.
Ministry press releases, including federal budget approvals and fiscal announcements.

sources.name_ar: التقارير الإحصائية - وزارة الموارد البشرية والتوطين
sources.description_en: Downloadable labour statistics (39 files in Oct 2026) by category - employment, establishments, complaints - e.g. employment distribution by economic activity and gender, growth of skilled workforce in the private sector.
Periodic labour-market data and the UAE's rankings in global labour competitiveness indices (IMD etc.), plus outputs of labour-market policies.
MoHRE press releases, including Emiratisation, inspections and private-sector workforce figures.

sources.name_ar: البيانات المفتوحة - وزارة الصحة ووقاية المجتمع
sources.description_en: MoHAP open datasets and statistical files (an open data API page is also published under /en/open-data/open-data-api).

sources.name_ar: لوحة الإحصاءات - وزارة الصحة ووقاية المجتمع
sources.description_en: Interactive dashboard of national health statistics.
MoHAP press releases on health programmes, campaigns and health-sector figures.

Education datasets: public and private schools, students by nationality, sector and gender, grade-12 graduates, school staff and teachers, education budget and expenditure (older Arabic PDF archives under /Ar/OpenData/Documents/).
Interactive education statistics dashboard of the Ministry of Education.

sources.name_ar: البيانات المفتوحة - وزارة التعليم العالي والبحث العلمي
sources.description_en: Higher-education open data hub with datasets, a data-visualisation page and a geospatial dashboard (page last modified Aug 2026).

sources.name_ar: البيانات المفتوحة - وزارة التغير المناخي والبيئة
sources.description_en: MOCCAE open datasets on environment, climate, agriculture, fisheries and food security, searchable by category and date (e.g. sea water quality indicators, XLSX).

sources.name_ar: الإصدارات والدراسات - وزارة الطاقة والبنية التحتية
sources.description_en: MoEI Knowledge Center publications and studies, searchable by category and year (list loads dynamically).
MoEI press releases on energy, infrastructure, transport and housing.

sources.name_ar: البيانات المفتوحة - وزارة الصناعة والتكنولوجيا المتقدمة
sources.description_en: MoIAT open data documents library by category (industrial, metrology, conformity, standards, accreditation, advanced technology) in PDF/Excel, plus interactive open data statistics.

sources.name_ar: الإصدارات والدراسات - وزارة الصناعة والتكنولوجيا المتقدمة
sources.description_en: MoIAT reports and studies on the industrial sector.
MoIAT press releases, including industrial output, exports and Make it in the Emirates figures.
Open data hub of the Ministry of Foreign Trade, including the International Trade Map (non-oil trade by partner, trade type and year) and data transparency dashboard.
Country and trade-partner economic reports published by the Ministry of Foreign Trade.
Ministry news, including non-oil foreign trade figures and CEPA announcements.
MoI open data files by type (police, traffic and licensing, civil defence, e-services, budget, geographic and real-time data), e.g. annual Traffic Cases XLSX files 2015-2025.
MoI press releases on traffic safety, policing and civil defence.

sources.name_ar: تقارير البيانات المفتوحة - الهيئة الاتحادية للهوية والجنسية والجمارك وأمن المنافذ
sources.description_en: ICP open data files (55 in Oct 2026, years 2010-2026), e.g. monthly statistics on the number of ICP service transactions (ID, residency, visas).

Statistics portal with key figures and downloadable databases by category, year and emirate (e.g. social welfare cases by emirate for 2024, volunteers) on social welfare, non-profit organisations and community participation.

sources.name_en: Ministry of Culture statistical reports and studies
sources.description_en: Statistical reports and studies filterable by category (general, culture, heritage, activities) and year (2000-2026), e.g. quarterly cultural centre visitor statistics and beneficiaries of cultural and creative centre services.

sources.name_en: Ministry of Sports statistics and studies
sources.description_en: Open data files (9 as of Apr 2026): medal counts, players and staff registered with sports entities, physical activity statistics in the UAE, ministry budget and service statistics; open data charts at /open-data-reports.

sources.name_ar: مجموعات البيانات - هيئة تنظيم الاتصالات والحكومة الرقمية
sources.description_en: 61 XLSX datasets (Oct 2026): phone and internet subscriptions (e.g. broadband subscriptions per 100 inhabitants), mobile network and smartphone benchmarking, service quality and prices, ICT access and use, spectrum and budget data.

sources.name_ar: إصدارات هيئة تنظيم الاتصالات والحكومة الرقمية
sources.description_en: TDRA reports and publications on the telecom sector and digital government.

sources.name_ar: المنصة الرسمية لحكومة الإمارات العربية المتحدة
sources.name_en: The Official Platform of the UAE Government (u.ae)
sources.description_en: The UAE Government's official unified digital platform (launched 2011, promoted by TDRA under its digital-government remit); its fact sheet and information pages (e.g. labour market data, open data guide) relay key national figures from the producing entities.

sources.name_ar: البيانات المفتوحة - الهيئة العامة للطيران المدني
sources.description_en: GCAA open data sets (31 in Oct 2026) on UAE civil aviation activity.

sources.name_ar: المركز الإعلامي - الهيئة العامة للطيران المدني
sources.description_en: GCAA news and press releases, including air-traffic and passenger figures.

sources.name_ar: البيانات المفتوحة - الهيئة الاتحادية للرقابة النووية
sources.description_en: FANR open data: general reports, general data and inspection reports, plus a glossary and link to Bayanat.ae.
FTA open data hub: open data files, visual open data and 3D open data pages, and the open data publication plan.
FTA press releases, e.g. corporate-tax and VAT registration counts and tourist VAT refunds.

CMA 'Numbers and Statistics' and 'Graphs and Statistics' pages on the UAE capital market, alongside open-data lists of registered and licensed companies and investment funds; the CMA annual report is still served from sca.gov.ae/assets.
CMA news and press releases, including market notices and regulatory figures.

ECI news items (individual pages under /en/news/) on export-credit support, partnerships and trade figures; there is no news listing URL, so the homepage is used as data_url. Annual reports are linked to an external host and not included.

sources.name_en: Ministry of Investment reports and insights
sources.description_en: FDI reports and sector whitepapers (e.g. FDI inflows of US$45.6bn in 2024); PDFs are served from invest.gov.ae and investuae.gov.ae.

sources.name_ar: البيانات المفتوحة - الهيئة الاتحادية للموارد البشرية الحكومية
sources.description_en: FAHR open data: federal government HR numbers and statistics, benchmarks and FAHR e-service usage; publications at /en/media-center/publications/.
Climate reports (daily and yearly climate report services) and NCM publications on UAE weather and climate.
MoJ open data section with 'Data & Statistics', open data services, governance and external platforms pages.

sources.name_ar: البيانات المفتوحة - مؤسسة الإمارات للخدمات الصحية
sources.description_en: EHS health reports and statistics: numbers and statistics, open data charts, budget, geospatial hospital data and real-time data on outpatient appointments, surgeries and referrals.
Arabic WAM newswire (latest news plus sections such as اقتصاد/business, أسواق/markets, عقارات/real estate, استثمار/investment, سياحة/tourism).
English WAM newswire (latest news plus sections such as Business, Markets, Real Estate, Investments, Tourism, Oil and Gas).
Cabinet news releases, e.g. federal budget approvals (AED 292.5bn 2027-2029 budget, Oct 2026) and Cabinet reviews of national competitiveness and development indicators.

Official Abu Dhabi statistics releases with downloadable Excel tables and PDF reports: GDP and national accounts, CPI and producer price index, non-oil foreign merchandise trade, industrial production index, building completions, hotel establishments, labour force, population, bank, education, health, climate, air/marine quality, waste, fishery and agriculture statistics; key indicators at /en/key-statistical-indicators.
SCAD's news and press releases announcing new statistical releases and headline figures (e.g. GDP growth, inflation, census results) for Abu Dhabi.
SCAD's official portal for the Abu Dhabi Census 2024 results: population size and composition, households and related census indicators.
Catalogue of open datasets published by Abu Dhabi government entities (launched 2020 with 550+ datasets across sectors), downloadable in multiple formats with a metadata API and real-time APIs.

sources.name_ar: المركز الإعلامي - دائرة الثقافة والسياحة أبوظبي
sources.description_en: DCT Abu Dhabi's media centre with news, circulars and annual reports (2017–2025) containing tourism and culture KPIs such as hotel guests, occupancy and visitor numbers. The on-site news list appears not to be updated recently; DCT's tourism figures are also announced via the Abu Dhabi Media Office, and SCAD publishes hotel establishment statistics.

sources.name_en: Abu Dhabi DED News and Highlights
sources.description_en: ADDED news and highlights announcing Abu Dhabi economic figures (non-oil growth, new business licences, investment and industrial-sector data); its publications section (/en/news-and-highlights/publications) holds brochures and guides.

sources.name_ar: لوحات البيانات المفتوحة - دائرة الصحة أبوظبي
sources.name_en: DoH Abu Dhabi Open Data Dashboards
sources.description_en: DoH's interactive Open Data Dashboards relaying the emirate's latest health statistics, with filters by period, trends and comparisons against international benchmarks; health-sector figures are also announced on DoH news (/en/news).
ADEK news releases with Abu Dhabi education figures (students, schools, nurseries, programmes). ADEK has no dedicated public statistics page; education statistics are also published by SCAD.

DMT news on municipal, construction, planning and transport projects and figures; DMT also publishes an engineering licensing and firm classification dashboard at pages.dmt.gov.ae/en/dashboard and an e-library.

News from Abu Dhabi Mobility (formerly branded Integrated Transport Centre, ITC; itc.gov.ae now redirects here) with public transport ridership, taxi, toll and parking figures. The news list is loaded dynamically.

ADREC's market data hub: dashboards with property transactions, price movements and market KPIs, an interactive map with real-time market trends and Quanta advanced reports (hub at /en/property_and_index).
Biannual (H1 and full-year) Abu Dhabi real estate market reports in PDF analysing transactions, prices and market performance (latest: H1 2026).

Department of Finance news on Abu Dhabi public finance and financial policy; its publications page (/en/Publications) holds the financial system law, chart of accounts and manuals. Abu Dhabi does not publish a detailed budget dataset here.

sources.name_ar: آخر أخبار أبوظبي - مكتب أبوظبي الإعلامي
sources.name_en: Abu Dhabi Media Office Latest News
sources.description_en: Official Abu Dhabi Government news releases relaying figures announced by Abu Dhabi departments and authorities (tourism, economy, real estate, health, agriculture, etc.).
Abu Dhabi Police media centre news with road safety, traffic accident and security figures. No dedicated public statistics page was found.

EAD research publications and reports on Abu Dhabi's environment (biodiversity, marine and groundwater, air quality, climate) from its Research Hub; environmental figures are also announced via EAD news (/en/Media-Centre/News).
EAD's real-time air quality monitoring portal showing the Air Quality Index, measured pollutants and weather readings by monitoring station across Abu Dhabi (real-time data subject to validation).

sources.name_ar: أخبار هيئة أبوظبي للزراعة والسلامة الغذائية
sources.description_en: ADAFSA news releases with Abu Dhabi agricultural production, farm, livestock and food safety inspection figures; publications at /en/awareness/Pages/publications.aspx.

DoE publications library including annual reports and annual technical reports with electricity, water and wastewater sector statistics (generation, capacity, peak demand, desalination output) plus policies; the list loads dynamically. Sector news at /en/Media-Centre/News.

sources.name_ar: مركز التقارير - سوق أبوظبي للأوراق المالية
sources.description_en: ADX market statistics: daily, weekly, monthly and yearly trading activity reports, sector trading, index performance, broker activity, and trading by investor type and nationality (legacy report tool at eservices.adx.ae/reportcenter.html). The site blocks automated clients (Cloudflare).

sources.name_en: DCD Abu Dhabi Publications and Research
sources.description_en: DCD publications, studies and research on Abu Dhabi's social sector (also /en/Media-Center/Research), including social survey results such as the sports and physical activity survey; news at /en/Media-Center/News. The list loads dynamically.
ADIO newsroom announcing Abu Dhabi investment partnerships and investment-attraction figures. Its reports page mostly links third-party and federal reports.

sources.name_en: Abu Dhabi Social Support Authority News
sources.description_en: SSA news releases on Abu Dhabi's social support programmes, including programme and beneficiary figures. The news list loads dynamically.
ADHA news and press releases on housing benefit packages, housing loans and citizen housing projects; publications at /en/Publications.

sources.name_en: Abu Dhabi Customs Foreign Trade Statistics
sources.description_en: Annual booklet of Abu Dhabi foreign trade statistics (trade between the emirate and world countries) and an annual performance report (/en/Annual-Performance-Report); the list loads dynamically. SCAD publishes the official monthly trade statistics.
ADGM announcements, including periodic growth figures for the financial centre (e.g. operational entities, assets under management) and regulatory actions by the FSRA and Registration Authority.

sources.name_en: Dubai official statistics (Data Dubai – Data and Statistics)
sources.description_en: DDSE statistics organised by theme (Population, Prices, National Accounts, Employment, Trade, Economic Sectors, Society, Digital Society, Infrastructure, Polls and Surveys): monthly Dubai CPI bulletin, annual Population Bulletin of the Emirate of Dubai, Emirati marriage/divorce rates, GDP and survey results, as Arabic/English PDFs and datasets. Replaces the former Dubai Statistics Center site dsc.gov.ae; the catalogue is rendered dynamically.

About 640 open datasets (Oct 2026) from Dubai entities including DDSE, Dubai Land Department, RTA, Dubai Municipality, DET, Dubai Customs, Dubai Airports, Dubai Courts, Public Prosecution and DEWA, mostly CSV with API endpoints on apis.data.dubai (an application key is required). Successor to Dubai Pulse (dubaipulse.gov.ae redirects here); update frequency varies by dataset.

sources.name_ar: الأبحاث والرؤى - دائرة الاقتصاد والسياحة في دبي
sources.name_en: DET Research and Insights (Tourism Performance Reports)
sources.description_en: Monthly year-to-date Tourism Performance Reports (overnight international visitors by source market, hotel occupancy, average daily rate, RevPAR), the Annual Visitor Report and other economic research. The site blocks automated clients (Akamai 403); URL verified via search index.

sources.name_ar: البيانات الصحفية - دائرة الاقتصاد والسياحة في دبي
sources.description_en: Official DET announcements with headline figures: visitor numbers, hotel performance, Dubai FDI Monitor results (FDI capital, projects, jobs), new business licences. The site blocks automated clients (Akamai 403); URL verified via search index.

Searchable official records of real estate transactions (sales, mortgages, gifts), rent contracts, projects, valuations, land, buildings, units, brokers and developers, filterable by date and area with CSV download; older years are on Data Dubai.

sources.name_en: DLD Research and Residential Sales Price Index
sources.description_en: DLD research reports, including the annual Real Estate Sector Performance report and the Residential Sales Price Index (monthly, quarterly and annual; methodology page at /en/open-data/residential-properties-price-index-rppi/).
DLD press releases announcing quarterly and annual real estate transaction volumes and values, investor numbers and market performance.

sources.name_en: DHA Open Data and Dubai Health Statistical Yearbook
sources.description_en: DHA open data page and statistical publications: the annual Dubai Health Statistical Yearbook (latest found: 2024 edition, published Dec 2025, with births, deaths, hospital admissions, outpatient visits, licensed facilities and workforce) and the Health Accounts System of Dubai (health expenditure). PDFs are served from dha.gov.ae/uploads; the page is rendered dynamically.

sources.name_ar: البيانات والإحصائيات - هيئة المعرفة والتنمية البشرية
sources.description_en: Open data workbooks on Dubai private schools (enrolment, curricula, ratings), early childhood centres and higher education institutions, plus private school, ECC and higher education landscape infographics.

Dubai Municipality announcements with figures on building permits, food safety inspections, waste and environment services. Its open data page (https://www.dm.gov.ae/open-data2/) lists datasets that are now hosted on Data Dubai.

sources.name_en: RTA Open Data (annual and statistical reports)
sources.description_en: RTA annual reports (to 2025), sustainability and governance reports and statistical reports (2011–2016 only), covering public transport ridership, road network, licensing and traffic safety.
RTA press releases announcing ridership of Dubai Metro, tram, buses, taxis and marine transport, Nol card and parking figures, and road projects.
Dubai Customs press releases with customs declaration counts, Dubai non-oil foreign trade figures and seizure statistics.

Official Government of Dubai news releases (Arabic at /ar/news) relaying figures announced by Dubai entities, e.g. budget, tourism, real estate, trade and FDI results; trace each figure back to the issuing entity.

Dubai Police open data: major crime rate per 100,000 population by crime type (2017–2024), emergency 999 calls received and answered, and traffic accident statistics. The current site is a single-page app; older pages under /wps/portal/home/opendata are still indexed.

sources.name_ar: الإحصاءات السنوية - هيئة كهرباء ومياه دبي
sources.description_en: Annual statistics booklets (2017–2025; 2025 edition April 2026) with installed capacity, electricity generation and peak load, water production, consumption by sector, customer numbers and clean-energy share. The site blocks automated clients (Akamai 403); URL verified via search index.

sources.name_ar: الموازنة العامة والمنشورات - دائرة المالية في دبي
sources.name_en: Dubai Government budget and fiscal publications
sources.description_en: Dubai Government general budget announcements (e.g. the 2026–2028 budget cycle: revenues, expenditure and sector allocations) and fiscal/economic overview publications from the DOF Public Debt Management Office (Dubai Overview at /en/dubai-overview/).

DFM trading bulletins, historical data (DFM General Index, sectors and listed companies, up to two years downloadable at /the-exchange/statistics-reports/historical-data/dfmgi), foreign ownership and ownership-holding statistics, and the weekly margin trading report.
Quarterly, half-year and annual traffic releases for DXB and DWC (passengers, flight movements, baggage, top destination markets) and the Dubai Airports fact file.

sources.name_ar: إصدارات دائرة الإحصاء والتنمية المجتمعية - الشارقة
sources.description_en: Sharjah Statistical Yearbook (2020-2024 editions online) and annual Statistical Bulletin (2024, 2025), plus statistical indicators (dscd.ae/en/statistical-indicators/) and Sharjah Census results (dscd.ae/sharjah-census/) covering population, vital statistics, economy, prices, education, health, tourism and environment.

Sharjah open data portal run by DSCD: 177+ datasets across 20 topics from Sharjah government publishers (population and vital statistics, national accounts, prices, real estate registration, tourism, business licences, education, health, electricity and water, traffic accidents, transportation, social services). JavaScript app; download formats could not be confirmed at check time.
SEDD annual reports (2023, 2024, 2025) and the Annual Report on Business Licenses (counts of new/renewed licences by activity), plus sector licence profiles (e.g. agriculture and livestock).

Official Sharjah government news releases (e.g. Sharjah Executive Council decisions, Census 2025 results, sector figures from Sharjah departments). Relays figures produced by other Sharjah entities. The news listing is rendered from the homepage (no stable listing URL could be confirmed), so the homepage is used as data_url.

sources.name_en: Sharjah Real Estate Registration Department news and market releases
sources.description_en: Monthly releases on Sharjah real estate trading (e.g. total transaction value and number of transactions per month, investor nationalities, mortgages) and the Sharjah Real Estate magazine; the site's monthly/annual reports sections were empty at check time, so the news page is the data_url.

sources.name_ar: التقارير والإحصاءات - هيئة الإنماء التجاري والسياحي
sources.description_en: Sharjah hotel and hotel-apartment statistics: guests, guest nights, occupancy, average length of stay, ADR and RevPAR, hotel and room counts by class, with quarterly and annual PDF reports for 2017-2025 and interactive charts.

Headline counters for Sharjah private education: number of private schools and curricula, Emirati and non-Emirati students, children in nurseries, training centres, and school inspection ratings distribution.

Ajman Statistical Yearbook, Emirate of Ajman Statistics, Ajman in Figures (annual), quarterly statistical bulletins, economic survey reports and environment (waste/wastewater) reports, plus interactive dashboards of Ajman indicators (births, licences, population, agriculture). Site is a JavaScript app; pages resolve in a browser.

Opendatasoft open data portal with ~197 datasets published by Ajman government entities (Municipality and Planning, Transport Authority, Tourism, Land and Real Estate Regulation, Economic Development, Ports and Customs, Ajman Police, Ajman Chamber, Finance); downloadable as CSV/JSON/Excel and via the Explore API v2.1.
13 DED datasets on Ajman Data: business licences by activity and by area, economic permits (promotions, sales, clearance) and related licensing statistics.

sources.name_ar: البيانات المفتوحة - دائرة الأراضي والتنظيم العقاري عجمان
sources.description_en: 18 datasets on land and unit sales, mortgages and transactions, registrations, real estate projects and brokers/offices (mirrored on data.ajman.ae), plus a daily 'Ajman Live' summary of transaction counts and values.

sources.name_ar: أخبار دائرة الأراضي والتنظيم العقاري - عجمان
sources.name_en: Ajman Land Department news (monthly transaction releases)
sources.description_en: Monthly press releases with Ajman real estate transaction totals (e.g. value and number of sales and mortgages per month).

21 tourism datasets on Ajman Data (still listed under the former publisher name 'Tourism Development Dept'): visitors and tourist groups, guest nights by hotel class, occupancy, RevPAR and related hotel indicators.

sources.name_ar: الكتاب الإحصائي - دائرة البلدية والتخطيط عجمان
sources.description_en: Annual Statistical Book (2022-2025 editions) with figures for public health and environment, infrastructure and building permits, and municipal services; the department also lists open datasets at am.gov.ae/en/open-data/.

sources.name_ar: الأخبار الرسمية - المكتب الإعلامي لحكومة عجمان
sources.description_en: Official Ajman government news, relaying figures announced by Ajman departments (real estate, economy, tourism, events).

Monthly CPI and 'RAK in <month>' bulletins, quarterly statistical bulletin and foreign trade report, annual RAK in Figures, Statistical Yearbook, GDP estimates and Labour Force Survey report; statistics by theme at css.rak.ae/en/home/statistics-themes/ and interactive dashboards.

Business licensing figures for Ras Al Khaimah (new licences, active licences, licensed capital by half-year/year). The site is a JavaScript app and no dedicated statistics/news page could be confirmed, so the homepage is used for both URLs; these figures are mostly published via WAM releases.

sources.name_ar: البيانات الصحفية - هيئة رأس الخيمة لتنمية السياحة
sources.description_en: Press releases with half-year and annual tourism performance (overnight visitor arrivals, source markets, hotel revenue); a Market Insights page (raktda.com/market-insights/) shows visitor and STR hotel indicators with an infographic PDF.

sources.name_ar: أخبار المكتب الإعلامي لحكومة رأس الخيمة
sources.description_en: Official RAK government news relaying figures from RAK entities; the news listing is updated irregularly (few recent items at check time).

Annual statistical book, quarterly reports, population statistics pages (fscfuj.gov.ae/population2024/), census 2011 report and a statistics dashboard (fscfuj.gov.ae/dashboard.html); website interface is English-only (Arabic link inactive).
Official Fujairah government news (mostly Ruler and Crown Prince activities); listing updated irregularly (latest items Nov 2025 at check time) and the server returns HTTP 500 with full content.

sources.name_ar: صندوق النقد الدولي - صفحة الإمارات العربية المتحدة
sources.name_en: IMF - United Arab Emirates country page
sources.description_en: IMF country page for the UAE listing Article IV consultation staff reports and press releases (latest: 2025 Article IV, December 2025) with GDP growth, inflation, fiscal balance, current account and banking-sector assessments and projections.

sources.name_ar: صندوق النقد الدولي - قاعدة بيانات آفاق الاقتصاد العالمي
sources.name_en: IMF World Economic Outlook database (IMF Data)
sources.description_en: World Economic Outlook dataset on the IMF Data portal with UAE real GDP growth, nominal GDP, inflation, government revenue/expenditure/debt, current account and population estimates and projections; published twice a year (April and October; latest October 2026 edition).

sources.name_ar: بيانات البنك الدولي - الإمارات العربية المتحدة
sources.name_en: World Bank Open Data - United Arab Emirates
sources.description_en: World Bank Open Data country page for the UAE with time series for GDP, population, labour force, trade, CO2 emissions, energy use, education, health and ICT indicators; Arabic mirror at data.albankaldawli.org and machine access via api.worldbank.org.
DataBank query tool for the World Development Indicators, the World Bank's main cross-country database (about 1,400 indicators) used to build custom UAE tables and downloads.

UNSD's data portal at data.un.org, now presented as the 'UN System Data Commons', aggregating UN-system statistics (national accounts, population, environment, SDG indicators) by country; the older UAE country-profile URL now returns 404 and a stable UAE page URL could not be confirmed, so the portal root is used.

sources.name_ar: قاعدة بيانات الأمم المتحدة لإحصاءات تجارة السلع (كومتريد)
sources.description_en: UN international merchandise trade database with annual and monthly import/export values by HS commodity and partner as reported by the UAE (reporter code 784) and mirrored by its partners; API at comtradeapi.un.org.

sources.name_ar: لوحة بيانات السياحة - منظمة الأمم المتحدة للسياحة
sources.description_en: Interactive dashboard of key tourism indicators by country (international arrivals, tourism receipts, outbound expenditure, accommodation) including the UAE; UN Tourism was known as UNWTO until its 2024 rename.

sources.name_ar: قاعدة بيانات إحصاءات السياحة - منظمة الأمم المتحدة للسياحة
sources.description_en: UN Tourism's country-reported tourism statistics (inbound, outbound, domestic, accommodation, tourism macroeconomic and employment, tourism SDG indicators) collected under IRTS 2008, offered as a bulk ZIP download; last updated 21 July 2026.

sources.name_ar: منظمة العمل الدولية - ILOSTAT - الإمارات العربية المتحدة
sources.name_en: ILOSTAT - United Arab Emirates country profile
sources.description_en: ILOSTAT country profile for the UAE with labour force participation, employment, unemployment and labour underutilization, working conditions and social protection indicators (latest household survey listed: Labour Force Survey 2025); site blocks automated clients, URL confirmed via search index.

IRENA's PX-Web statistics database with renewable installed capacity, electricity generation, off-grid and public finance flows by country including the UAE; a UAE renewable energy statistical profile (PDF) is linked from irena.org/Data/Energy-Profiles.

Annual bulletin of crude oil and gas reserves, production, refining, exports and oil revenues by country (61st edition ASB-2026 launched 29 April 2026 with data to end-2025; interactive version at publications.opec.org/asb). The UAE left OPEC and OPEC+ effective 1 May 2026, so UAE data here covers its membership years; check later editions for continued coverage.

sources.name_ar: بوابة البيانات الإحصائية (مرسى) - المركز الإحصائي الخليجي
sources.description_en: GCC-Stat's 'Marsa' data portal with harmonised datasets for GCC states including the UAE across 16 domains (population, national accounts, labour, prices, foreign trade, tourism, energy, monetary and financial, water, waste), with dataset downloads and a developers' corner.
GCC-Stat statistical publications, studies and summaries (economic, demographic and social, environment and sustainable development statistics) comparing GCC member states including the UAE.

sources.name_ar: بيانات منظمة الصحة العالمية - الإمارات العربية المتحدة
sources.description_en: WHO country data page for the UAE drawing on the Global Health Observatory: life expectancy, healthy life expectancy, causes of death, mortality, risk factors and health-system indicators.

sources.name_ar: وكالة الطاقة الدولية - ملف الإمارات العربية المتحدة
sources.name_en: IEA - United Arab Emirates energy profile
sources.description_en: IEA country profile for the UAE with energy mix, total energy supply, electricity generation by source, renewables share, oil and natural gas, efficiency/demand and energy-related CO2 emissions; site blocks automated clients, URL confirmed via search index.
